name: Sint-Petrus-en-Pauluskerk
description: This Old Catholic church, parsonage and teaching room were built in 1913–1914 to Johan W.F. Hartkamp’s design. The church continued the congregation of De Ooievaar in the Barndesteeg. Its rationalist brick architecture includes a neo-Romanesque entrance and a chamfered clock tower; inside, eighteenth-century furnishings from Amsterdam’s earlier hidden churches survive, including the rotating tabernacle and carved pulpit.
